claims.statement: Leonardo's will names Francesco Melzi heir to books and instruments and divides the Milan vineyard between Salai and a servant.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Notarial act drawn up at Amboise.
